title: Unearned Share on Removal of an Optional Coverage Add-Ons Rider: Free Look and Regional Refund Methods
content:
**Contract terms extract.** The unearned share of the removal credit for a rider of the Optional Coverage Add-Ons follows the timing of the removal and the refund method in Bridgewell's filed contract terms for the region where the base homeowner property lies, read from the property ZIP code recorded on the base Homeowner Service Contracts contract. In each method the rider's start is the later of the term start date and the add date.

| Removal timing | Property ZIP code | Unearned share |
|---|---|---|
| No later than the rider's free-look period of 30 calendar days after the add date | Any | One: the whole retained premium is unearned |
| Later | 43000 through 45999 (Ohio) or 75000 through 79999 (Texas), where those terms refund by the day | The calendar days after the removal date through the term end date, divided by the days from the rider's start through the term end date, both days counted |
| Later | Any other ZIP code | The whole months from the removal date to the term end date, divided by the whole months from the rider's start to the term end date, counting that divisor as at least one month |

The days after the add date are counted with the add date as day zero.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- A rider added on 1 March and removed on 31 March, the 30th calendar day after the add date: the share is one.
- The same rider removed on 1 April, the 31st day: the share follows the property's region.

## Worked figures (hypothetical dates)

A rider whose start is 1 January, on a term ending 31 December (365 days), removed on 10 May after its free-look period.

| Property ZIP code | Unearned share |
|---|---|
| 44101 (Ohio) | 235 days after 10 May through 31 December, divided by 365: about 0.6438 |
| 76102 (Texas) | The same day-based share: about 0.6438 |
| 46204 | 7 whole months divided by 11 whole months: about 0.6364 |
